sql: select 'o' k, market_ticker, created_at::text t, left(client_order_id,14)||' '||action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'x'||quantity||' '||status||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,'') v from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT27-%' and created_at > '2026-10-20' union all select 's', market_ticker, at::text, best_yes_bid||'/'||best_no_bid||' '||left(no_levels_json::text,60) from incentive_market_snapshots where market_ticker='KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT27-SAVE' and at between '2026-10-20 14:10' and '2026-10-20 15:00' order by 1,3
